title: "Analyzing US Births"
author: "Emma Acedo"
execute:
  echo: false
---
```{r}
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
library(readxl)
```

```{r}
births <- read_excel("data/us_births_1994_2014.xlsx")
glimpse(births)
```

```{r}
#| cache: true
births_tibble <- read_excel("data/us_births_1994_2014.xlsx") |>
  mutate(day_of_week = factor(
    day_of_week,
    levels = c("Sun", "Mon", "Tues", "Wed", "Thurs", "Fri", "Sat"),
    ordered = TRUE
  ))
```

```{r}
births_tibble |>
  group_by(month, date_of_month) |>
  summarize(mean_births = mean(births), .groups = "drop")
```

```{r}
births_tibble |>
  group_by(month, date_of_month) |>
  summarize(mean_births = mean(births), .groups = "drop") |>
  ggplot(aes(x = date_of_month, y = month, fill = mean_births)) +
  geom_tile() +
  scale_y_reverse(breaks = 1:12, labels = month.name) +
  labs(x = "Day of month", y = "Month", fill = "Mean births")
```

```{r}
births_tibble |>
  filter(month == 12) |>
  group_by(year) |>
  summarize(
    births_dec_25 = sum(births[date_of_month == 25]),
    surrounding_average = mean(births[date_of_month %in% c(20:24, 27:30)]),
    pct_of_baseline = births_dec_25 / surrounding_average * 100,
    weekday = day_of_week[date_of_month == 25],
    .groups = "drop"
  )
```

```{r}
births_tibble |>
  filter(month == 12) |>
  group_by(year) |>
  summarize(
    births_dec_25 = sum(births[date_of_month == 25]),
    surrounding_average = mean(births[date_of_month %in% c(20:24, 27:30)]),
    pct_of_baseline = births_dec_25 / surrounding_average * 100,
    weekday = day_of_week[date_of_month == 25],
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = year, y = pct_of_baseline)) +
  geom_line() +
  geom_point(aes(color = weekday)) +
  labs(
    x = "Year",
    y = "December 25 births (% of baseline)",
    color = "Weekday"
  )
```
```{r}
births_model <- lm(
  births ~ factor(year) + factor(month) + factor(day_of_week),
  data = births_tibble
)

summary(births_model)$r.squared
```
```{r}
births_adjusted <- births_tibble |>
  mutate(pct_resid = resid(births_model) / mean(births) * 100)

calendar_resid <- births_adjusted |>
  filter(!(month == 2 & date_of_month == 29)) |>
  group_by(month, date_of_month) |>
  summarize(pct_resid = mean(pct_resid), .groups = "drop") |>
  mutate(date = as.Date(sprintf("2001-%02d-%02d", month, date_of_month)))

calendar_resid
```
```{r}
holidays <- calendar_resid |>
  filter(date %in% as.Date(c("2001-01-01", "2001-07-04", "2001-12-25"))) |>
  mutate(holiday = c("New Year's Day", "Independence Day", "Christmas"))

ggplot(calendar_resid, aes(x = date, y = pct_resid)) +
  geom_line() +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_text(
    data = holidays,
    aes(label = holiday),
    nudge_y = 1.5,
    check_overlap = TRUE
  ) +
  labs(x = "Calendar date", y = "Mean residual (% of average births)")
```
